title: Most Americans want AI kept out of advising people about God
subtitle: U.S. adults, June 2025
caption: Nearly three in four Americans (73%) say AI should play no role at all in advising people about their faith in God, more than say the same about matchmaking, governing or choosing juries.
note: Share who say artificial intelligence should play "no role at all" in each area. The report gives no breakdown by religion.
